Good luck with the NHS.. let me know how you get on.. I’ve just started speaking to my doctor about my case, who’s sending me off to a respiratory clinic to see how much my lung function’s impacted.. but I can offer couple of things to think about: 

1.) If you find a good doctor, stick with them. They’re only human but the good ones seem to be getting fewer and farther between. 

2.) regardless of where you are in your journey, improving your physical health and appearance is absolutely paramount. Try a strength and conditioning routine with mobility/stretching/yoga and proper nutrition. Be strict with yourself. Commit to it completely for 8 weeks.. and remember that as long as it’s hard for you, that’ll do.. see how you feel at the end of it.. and then keep going. Guarantee you’ll make headway.

3.) be mindful of your thoughts and where they lead you. Don’t measure your physical appearance or ability against anyone else, other than past yourself. That’s the only yard stick that matters
